requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with Increased Yield
requirements.Description: Implement new NGB keyed ink bottles with 6K Black and 6K CMY page yield, and ensure CMY bottles are available in sizes >8K.
requirements.Rationale: To increase page yield and reduce frequency of ink replacement, supporting higher volume users and competitive positioning.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle design, IDS compatibility, tank size increase
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given new NGB bottles are installed, the system must recognize the keying and deliver 6,000 pages for Black and CMY; CMY bottles should be available in >8K capacity.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Bottle Reliability
requirements.Description: Ensure that the new NGB bottles provide spill-free operation during installation and replacement.
requirements.Rationale: To improve user experience and reduce mess or damage from ink spills, a key differentiator in CISS market.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: When a user installs or replaces an ink bottle, there should be no ink spillage under normal use conditions.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate NOA-F with a metal foiled labyrinth and a lid label, without changing the click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance product security, ensure compatibility with existing mechanisms, and improve anti-counterfeiting.
requirements.Dependencies: NOA-F design, existing click-on and TDF mechanisms
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F must include a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, and install using the same push-push and TDF mechanisms as current products.

requirements.Title: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment inks without any reformulation.
requirements.Rationale: To leverage existing investments and proven technology, reducing R&D costs and time to market.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie inks are used as-is without reformulation in the Magellan system.

requirements.Title: Reliability and Performance Characterization
requirements.Description: Characterize and model reliability, WVTR, air gain, flow rate, IDS performance, including startup and NOA-F end-of-life (EOL).
requirements.Rationale: To ensure robust operation, meet performance targets, and support warranty claims.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Documented models and test data for reliability, WVTR, air gain, flow rate, IDS, with startup and NOA-F EOL scenarios covered.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modelling
requirements.Description: Model ink stability in the tank and assess impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: To ensure long-term print quality and reliability for high-yield systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink stability model and PQ impact report available for review.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Parts for Warranty Support
requirements.Description: Provide NOA-F as service parts for warranty support.
requirements.Rationale: To enable in-warranty replacement and maintenance, reducing downtime and improving customer satisfaction.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F available as service part for all warranty claims within specified period.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 on the lid of the product.
requirements.Rationale: To support product authentication, tracking, or advanced features as defined by Acumen 6.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 feature is present and functional on the product lid.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 line to support NOA-F production.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure manufacturing readiness for new NOA-F features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SA14 line is modified and validated for NOA-F production.

requirements.Title: Add Magi Ink Cart and Labelling Tool in Orcus 5
requirements.Description: Equip Orcus 5 line with Magi ink cartridge and labelling tool to support new product.
requirements.Rationale: To enable assembly of new ink system and proper product labelling.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Orcus 5 line operational with Magi ink cart and labelling tool integrated.

requirements.Title: Assemble PHA, Dry FI, USG, Push-Push in Printer Factory
requirements.Description: Ensure PHA, Dry FI, USG, and push-push mechanisms are assembled in the printer factory.
requirements.Rationale: To streamline assembly and ensure quality control.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All specified components are assembled in-printer at the factory.

requirements.Title: ISDO Capex for NOA-F and Ink Cart Tooling
requirements.Description: Allocate ISDO Capex for SA14 line (NOA-F), Magi and Nessie ink cart, labelling tool in Orcus 5, and mold for 1-4 new keyed caps.
requirements.Rationale: To fund necessary manufacturing upgrades for new product requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Capex allocated and tools/molds procured for production.

requirements.Title: Support Customer-Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design product to allow end-users to replace PHA and NOA-F components easily.
requirements.Rationale: To improve serviceability and reduce downtime for customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End-users can replace PHA and NOA-F without special tools, as validated by usability testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80K Pages
requirements.Description: Set new warranty page life goal to 80,000 pages for the product.
requirements.Rationale: To meet competitive warranty standards and support high-volume users.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product maintains print quality and reliability up to 80,000 pages under normal use.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Increased Tank Size
requirements.Description: Adopt Reddington ID with an increase in tank size, but no change to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: To accommodate higher ink volumes while maintaining product identity.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product design includes increased tank size as per Reddington ID, with ADF unchanged.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam for product packaging.
requirements.Rationale: To protect the product during shipping and handling.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All shipped units use EPS foam packaging, validated by drop/impact tests.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance
requirements.Description: Ensure product compliance with EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel (for PDL SKU) environmental standards.
requirements.Rationale: To meet regulatory and market requirements for eco-friendly products.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is certified as compliant with EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel for applicable SKUs.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Redesign input and output trays to align with the new tank protrusion.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure mechanical compatibility and user convenience with larger tanks.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays function properly and accommodate the tank protrusion without interference.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphic Display) into the product.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance user interface and experience with a larger, clearer display.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product includes a 4.3” CGD that passes usability and readability tests.

requirements.Title: Leverage Sayan Sibstar Tubes with New Routing and Integration
requirements.Description: Use Sayan Sibstar tubes and implement new tube routing and integration in the platform (4 tubes).
requirements.Rationale: To improve ink delivery and system reliability in the new tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product uses specified tubes with validated routing and integration.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Update service station for improved aerosol management, accommodating changes due to the new tank.
requirements.Rationale: To maintain clean operation and prolong service station life.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service station manages aerosols effectively in all operational modes.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force models to account for tube routing and increased weights.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure reliable printhead movement and avoid mechanical failures.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage operates within force and speed tolerances with updated tube and weight configuration.

requirements.Title: Paper Path to Support Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Redesign paper path to support increased page life (80k pages).
requirements.Rationale: To ensure durability and reliability for higher duty cycles.
requirements.Dependencies: Paper path design, page life goal
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path components maintain functionality for at least 80,000 pages.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part (Post 80k Life)
requirements.Description: Design the ink maintenance component as a serviceable part for replacement after 80,000 pages (service center).
requirements.Rationale: To extend product life and maintain print quality beyond warranty period.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink maintenance component design, service documentation
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance part can be replaced by service center after 80,000 pages.

requirements.Title: 140ml K Bottles and New CMY Bottle Sizes
requirements.Description: Introduce new 140ml Black (K) bottles and new capacity CMY bottles for the product.
requirements.Rationale: To support higher page yields and reduce refill frequency.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product supports 140ml K bottles and new CMY bottles as specified.

requirements.Title: IDS Make-Break and FI Connection Update
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and FI connection for the IDS system, leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: To improve ink delivery, security, and compatibility with new bottle/tank system.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS design, LEBI tank, SHAID integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS system operates reliably with new connections and security features.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop a new IDS startup algorithm and air management process for the ink system.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure reliable startup and minimize air-related failures in the ink path.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup algorithm and air management validated through reliability testing.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Definition
requirements.Description: Set new print quality (PQ) goals and define depletion to align with page yield targets.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure print quality is maintained throughout the specified yield.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product maintains PQ within defined limits for full page yield.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Reuse existing Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU components in the new product.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce development cost and leverage proven hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product uses specified ASICs and PSU without modification.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate the Stingray Wi-Fi module into the product for wireless connectivity.
requirements.Rationale: To provide up-to-date wireless networking capability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes Wi-Fi certification and user connectivity tests with Stingray module.

requirements.Title: FW Dune Integration
requirements.Description: Use Dune firmware (FW) for the product platform.
requirements.Rationale: To unify firmware development and leverage existing features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product operates reliably with Dune FW and passes all FW validation tests.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate Gauss4.xx security features at both hardware and firmware levels.
requirements.Rationale: To meet current security requirements and protect user data.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes security certification and penetration testing with Gauss4.xx features enabled.

requirements.Title: Support for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise Segments
requirements.Description: Product must support business models and services for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise customers.
requirements.Rationale: To maximize market reach and address different customer needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product SKUs and software/services available for all three segments.

requirements.Title: Scan Solution Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solution for all supported business segments.
requirements.Rationale: To provide a complete MFP (multi-function printer) offering.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product includes scan functionality that meets segment requirements.

requirements.Title: SMB Manageability Features
requirements.Description: Include manageability features targeted at SMB customers.
requirements.Rationale: To improve product appeal and ease of management for SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product includes SMB management features as defined in requirements doc.

requirements.Title: Enterprise Support for WJA, HPSM, JAM
requirements.Description: Provide support for enterprise management solutions: Web Jetadmin (WJA), HP Smart Management (HPSM), and JAM.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure seamless integration into enterprise IT environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes integration and functionality tests with WJA, HPSM, and JAM.

requirements.Title: Client and Driver Support: HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD
requirements.Description: Ensure product compatibility with HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers.
requirements.Rationale: To maximize compatibility and ease of use across platforms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product installs and operates with all listed clients and drivers.

requirements.Title: Leverage Watt-LE/Marconi-Hi Mech + CISS
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Watt-LE/Marconi-Hi mechanical platform and CISS technology for product development.
requirements.Rationale: To minimize development time and capitalize on proven architectures.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is built on specified mechanical and CISS platforms.

requirements.Title: Speed: 25/20ppm (PDL: 25/19ppm)
requirements.Description: Product must achieve print speeds of 25/20 ppm (pages per minute), and for PDL, 25/19 ppm.
requirements.Rationale: To meet market expectations for speed and competitiveness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product achieves specified speeds in standard test conditions.

requirements.Title: Serviceability: Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Design the maintenance box for easy serviceability.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce service time and improve end-user experience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be serviced/replaced within defined time and tool constraints.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life: 2 Years
requirements.Description: Product must offer a warranty life of 2 years or the equivalent page count, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: To align with market standards and provide customer assurance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is covered under warranty for 2 years or up to 80,000 pages.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K Pages
requirements.Description: SuperAmp PHA must be rated for a minimum life of 65,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure reliability and reduce service interventions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA passes reliability tests for at least 65,000 pages.
